articles.summary: The axiom.ai Selector tool allows you to select elements from a page to make use of within your automation. For example, when using the Enter text step this will allow you to select the text field that you want to enter text into. There are two versions of this tool depending on which step you are using it in. We are primarily discussing the Multi-Selector tool within this article, but it’s still important to know about the Single-Selector tool.
articles.title: Mastering the Multi-selector Tool
